articles.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.snippet: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

articles.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
articles.snippet: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

articles.title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
articles.snippet: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

articles.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
articles.snippet: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
